notes: Hand-keyed from the PDF pages named on each point. Shape: series.<key> = { label, unit, cadence, geography, population, edition, points: [{ p, g, start?, v, doc, page, quote, locator?, note?, approx?, estimate?, provisional? }], caveats, restatement?, feeds?, catalogKey? }. p is the period end (ISO), g the grain (year, half, quarter, ytd, ttm, asof, window, rolling6m), doc a key of documents. Keys are the series-catalog group 2 keys; a catalog row that mixed units or populations is split into one key per measure, the catalog key keeping the primary measure and every sibling carrying catalogKey (see splits). A key may recur across the report files; points are unioned by key, and the same key, date and grain in two files is a restatement in which the later document's asOf wins. Threshold wording ('exceeds', 'almost', 'more than') is flagged approx; report estimates are flagged estimate; latest-period prints are flagged provisional. Catalog verifier corrections applied: the 2022 edition fund count has 2020 = 414 and 2021 = 330 (re-confirmed by label position on the page); the 2021-edition restatement note follows; pb_pd_dry_powder_headline's 31.1% and lcd_lbo_loan_volume_annual's -58% are split out as their own percentage keys; locators are page-and-chart, not pdftotext lines. Corrections to the catalog found on the pages: the 'not enough observations in Q4 2022' note sits on the 2024 report p.18 chart, not in the 2022 report; the direct lending share, regional split and $146.0B pairing are on the 2022 report p.6, not p.5; the 2024 report's distribution-rate end labels are dated to the chart's as-of (June 30, 2024) because its last x-axis label (Q1 2024) is one of a pair.
